title: evidencepack/collector-result@v1
description: What a collector could not measure and why, what its output checks found, the calls it made, the identity it signed in as, and when it ran.

name.description: The collector's name, as its spec declares it.

version.description: The collector's version, such as v0.3.0. Absent when the build set none.

commit.description: The source commit the collector was built from. Absent when the build set none.

collector.description: The collector that produced the run.

status.description: collected when the run read every value its level collects, or partial when it left values out. gaps lists each one.

code.description: For a partial run, the code of the first gap, saying why its value was left out.

owner.description: For a partial run, who can act on that code.

gaps.description: One entry per value the collector left out of an artifact, and why.

checks.description: The first 100 findings of the output checks the SDK runs on each artifact it writes. Absent when there are none.

checks_dropped.description: Number of findings left out after the first 100.

steps.description: The named parts of the run, in the order they started, at every level. Absent when the collector opens none.

operations.description: One entry per kind of call, with its counts.

requests.description: One row per request, at the audit and internal levels: the first 1000, then up to 1000 more whose attempt failed or was a retry.

requests_dropped.description: Number of request rows left out.

problem_requests_dropped.description: Number of the rows left out whose attempt failed or was a retry. Present wherever the rows are; 0 means every failed or retried request has a row.

calls.description: The API calls the collector made.

provider.description: The identity system, such as okta or microsoft-entra.

kind.description: The kind of principal, such as service_app, service_principal, or user.

tenant_id.description: The tenant, account, or organization signed in to.

auth_method.description: How the collector proved its identity, such as private_key_jwt for OAuth 2.0 client credentials with a signed key assertion or api_token for an API token.

requested_scopes.description: The scopes the collector asked for. A scope here and missing from scopes was not granted.

read_only.description: Present when the collector can show that its credential could only read.

id.description: Present at the audit and internal levels only.

signed_in_as.description: The identity the collector signed in as. Absent when the collector does not report one.

run_id.description: The run ID the runner passed in EPACK_RUN_ID. Absent when it passed none.

started_at.description: When the run started, in RFC 3339 UTC.

finished_at.description: When the run finished, in RFC 3339 UTC.

proxy.description: True when a proxy variable such as HTTPS_PROXY was set for the run.

custom_ca.description: True when SSL_CERT_FILE or SSL_CERT_DIR was set for the run.

run.description: When the run happened and how its network was set up.

schema.description: The schema of the artifact the value belongs in, when the run wrote no such artifact.

path.description: The artifact the value belongs in. Absent when the run wrote no such artifact, in which case schema names it.

pointer.description: JSON pointer to the value within the artifact. Items are addressed by array index.

status.description: not_collected when the collector could not read the value. partial when a rollup was left out because some of the items it covers could not be read, or when a list or object holds only the items that could be.

code.description: Why the value was left out: auth_failed, permission_denied, config_invalid, not_licensed, rate_limited, vendor_error, timeout, invalid_response, or internal.

owner.description: Who can act on the code: customer, nobody for an expected gap such as a feature the plan lacks, vendor, vendor_or_runner, or publisher.

vendor_code.description: The vendor's own error code, when its response included one.

unmeasured.description: For a partial gap, the number of items that could not be read.

operation.description: The operation whose failed call left the value out. Absent when no call's error caused the gap, such as for a feature the plan lacks.

call.description: The number of that call, matching the call on its request rows. A partial gap names the first failed call among those it counts.

source.description: The file and line in the collector's own source that recorded the gap, relative to its module root, such as internal/collector/system_log.go:155.

missing_permission.description: For a permission_denied gap, the permission to grant, in the vendor's own terms, such as okta.logs.read.

warning.description: The collector's message to the operator about the gap, redacted. Present at the audit and internal levels only.

detail.description: Present at the audit and internal levels only.

check.description: schema, schema_unusable, population, nulls, rollups, or ratios.

path.description: The artifact the finding is about. A schema_unusable finding has none.

pointer.description: JSON pointer to the value the finding is about.

name.description: The operation's name, such as okta.users.list.

calls.description: Number of times the collector made the call, not counting retries.

attempts.description: Number of requests sent, including retries.

retries.description: Number of requests that were retries.

statuses.description: Number of responses per HTTP status code, or per DNS response code for a lookup.

errors.description: Number of failed attempts per code.

deprecation.description: The Deprecation header from the vendor's most recent response that carried one.

sunset.description: The Sunset header from the vendor's most recent response that carried one.

name.description: The step's name, such as people. Step names are part of the collector's contract, like operation names.

title.description: The step's title, such as People and sign-in methods.

start_ms.description: When the step started, in milliseconds after the run's started_at.

end_ms.description: When the step ended, in milliseconds after the run's started_at. A step still open when the collector emitted ended then.

requests.description: The requests sent in the step, including rows left out of calls.requests.

calls.description: The calls those requests belong to.

failed.description: The attempts that failed: those with an error code or a status of 400 or more.

operations.description: Each operation called in the step, in the order first called, with its number of calls.

call.description: The call's number in the run, counting from 1 in the order calls start. Every attempt of one call has the same number.

operation.description: The operation the request belongs to.

step.description: The step the call was made in. Absent for a call made outside every step.

method.description: The HTTP method, DNS and the record type looked up, such as DNS TXT, or DIAL.

host.description: The request's host, the name a DNS lookup queried, or the host dialed.

query_keys.description: Names of the request's query parameters. Their values are not recorded.

attempt.description: Which attempt the request was: 1 for the first, higher for a retry.

start_ms.description: When the attempt was sent, in milliseconds after the run's started_at.

waited_ms.description: On a retry, how long the SDK waited before sending it: the Retry-After value, the rate limit reset, or its own backoff. Absent on a first attempt and on a retry sent at once.

status.description: The response's HTTP status code. Absent when no response arrived.

rcode.description: DNS lookups only: the response code. A lookup that got no response has none.

error.description: The code for a request that failed. Absent when it succeeded.

vendor_code.description: The vendor's own error code from a failed response, such as E0000047. Never the vendor's message. Absent for collectors that do not read one.

duration_ms.description: How long the request took, in milliseconds.

request_id.description: The vendor's request ID from the response headers, when it sent one.
